steps.title: A program starts
steps.note: fanotify pauses the exec on /, /tmp and /dev/shm and hands the file to Aegis.

steps.title: Both engines look
steps.note: YARA-X scans the bytes; the heuristics read the context (writable dir, reverse shell, canary).

steps.title: The policy decides
steps.note: Detection mode: medium severity waits for you, high is quarantined. Prevention mode: blocked.

steps.title: You act in the dashboard
steps.note: Restore, delete or exclude the path. The tray icon turns red until you look.
